Mirror and patterns of a scoped Extrude Cut (mitcad#2126, GitHub #495) on a reported design (opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/scoped-cut-mirror-reported-test.cmake): two components, a cylinder (F2.b0, radius 25, 20.5 high) in C1 and a smaller one (F4.b0, radius 21.06, 10 high) in C2 standing on its top, and a pocket (F6, radius 5.95 at x = -11.9, 5 deep) cut into C2's top with an automatic target scope. The pocket does not reach C1. Before the fix every mirror or pattern of the pocket failed (`unsupported cut scope for feature replay: automatic scope includes another component or occurrence`) because C1 has a body.
Mirrored about the plane x = 0 of C2: a second pocket at x = 11.9 in C2's body; C1's body unchanged.
The same copy by a rectangular pattern along X (two pockets 23.81 apart), Identical.
